from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InvestingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Net cash flow from investing activities reported in one company's financial statements."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Net cash flow from investing activities; negative for used, positive for provided")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the amount, e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands'")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written in the statement")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the amount and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    investing_cash_flows: list[InvestingCashFlow]
